subject.title: [Bug]: Discord sessions persist per-session exec directives, causing allowlist mode to behave unexpectedly after config changes

question: Should persisted per-session /exec fields be allowed to override later stricter global or agent exec security config after a Discord session resumes?
rationale: Current source and tests intentionally preserve per-session exec defaults, but this creates a security-sensitive operator-policy shadowing case when global config changes after the session field was persisted.

options.title: Make global or agent policy the upper bound
options.body: Clamp or clear stored session exec fields that exceed current operator policy, with focused upgrade/reset coverage.

options.title: Keep per-session persistence
options.body: Document that operators must reset sessions or use a repair path to enforce changed exec policy for existing lanes.

options.title: Add explicit reset first
options.body: Ship an operator-facing session exec reset or doctor repair before changing precedence semantics.

recommendation.title: Make global or agent policy the upper bound
recommendation.body: Clamp or clear stored session exec fields that exceed current operator policy, with focused upgrade/reset coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The clearest feature and test history for the /exec session override behavior points to this owner path.
